verdict.rationale: All evidence describes Undermind functioning as an MCP *server* that other clients (Cursor, VS Code, Claude) connect to in order to use Undermind's own research tools — the opposite direction from this story, which asks whether a user can plug external MCP servers into Undermind so it can use their tools. No evidence shows Undermind acting as an MCP client or consuming third-party MCP tool servers. Missing for 10: any documentation or feature letting users add/configure external MCP servers within Undermind, evidence of Undermind invoking third-party MCP tools, or any client-side MCP configuration.
